access_description: Public ESMA registers page and MiFIR reporting description for instrument reference data. No FIRDS file was downloaded.
auth_requirement: No key is stated on the registers legal notice. The data.europa.eu catalogue page does not state a dataset licence.
conditions: Do not download FIRDS files. The registers notice authorises reproduction of registers information only if the source is acknowledged and further conditions are met, and it says third-party copyright still needs permission. That is not a clearance for automated collection.
revision_behaviour: ESMA describes full and delta reference files. This assessment did not open a file, so the revision behaviour of a stored row is unknown.
unresolved_questions: Whether venue-submitted FIRDS records are ESMA-owned registers information or third-party material. Whether bulk file download is covered by the registers notice. AI processing and model training are not stated.
evidence_note: On 23 October 2026 the registers legal notice said ESMA owns copyright in site material except legislative text and other third-party materials, and that reproduction is authorised if the source is acknowledged, with extra conditions for sold documents and transformed republication. data.europa.eu lists the dataset as public and says users must consult the original portal when a dataset licence is absent. No FIRDS file was downloaded.
